meta.axes: x forward (right on screen), z up; the runner moves toward +x
meta.pose: [x, z, angle] per body, in skeleton order; body frame origin in world coordinates
meta.angle_convention: counter-clockwise positive with +x right and +z up; a point (u, v) in the body frame is at (x + u cos a - v sin a, z + u sin a + v cos a)
meta.skeleton_geometry: geom from/to/center are in the body frame, [x, z]
